# Service schema: actual_collections

This page describes public records for this service type. Read the current service_cases record for its kind and ID; use explicit case_id references where present. Nested fields are output paths, not dotted search filters.

## service_bookings

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in service_cases. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `cash_after_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Cash after amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `cash_delta_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Signed change in the operating wallet caused by this booking: positive adds cash; negative removes cash. |
| `event_id` | string | Top-level filter | Event id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `event_kind` | string | Top-level filter | Event kind: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `kind` | string | Top-level filter | Record or service type. Fields and meanings can differ between kinds. Public values represented here: `bank_event`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Logical event or posting minute measured from the session clock, not wall-clock runtime. |
| `receipt` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Recorded external or bank receipt. Null/unavailable receipt is not an approved outcome. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
